args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the "PHL" label confusion in the Coastal reports.

- Covey & Lark Retail was renamed Pellow Home Living on 16 Feb 2026. It is the same Mid-Atlantic home goods account under a new name.
- "PHL" now points at two customers: Pellow Home Living and Pellucid Harbor Logistics. Filtering the morning report on "PHL" returns rows for both.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- Moss's coverage digest (18 May) says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". The old label made the Pellow receiving supervisor search twice, and the label change went on the handoff list. I can't see whether it has been fixed since.
- Moss's Coastal cheat sheet still lists the account as "Covey & Lark Retail (Covey / CLR / PHL)", so that needs updating too.

Could you confirm the saved report is relabelled (e.g. "Pellow Home Living — Late Arrivals") and agree a short code that isn't ambiguous, since "PHL" is shared?

Thanks,
Bettina
